title: 第19章 武道也敢来碰瓷我修仙长生大道第20章 萧火火 三长老放心吧我不会伤到你的
slug: 说好武侠世界你怎么教人修仙
lines: 萧家大堂。
萧斩四人將簫火火围在了中心，紧紧的盯著他看。
若是平常，他们四人都只会当，是簫火火从那个话本里学来的胡话，不会放在心上。
可如今，萧火火可是带了一位令整个离火国都是忽视不了的，超越大宗师之境的师傅回来。
这簫火火所说之话，就让他们难以忽视了。
方才那句话，像是戳动了什么痒点一般，在四人的心中迴荡。
大长老也同样看向簫火火。
他单手拄著拐杖，眉头拧成了川字，不解的道：
“族长问的是。”
“火火，你那九道灵气，还有修仙都是什么东西。”
“老夫活了几十年，游遍了整个江南道，为何从未听说过？”
大长老抬头看向楚风：
【记住全网最快小説站1?1???.???】
“难不成，是前辈的什么特殊功法，对武者境界的称称？”
不止是大长老，就是余下的萧斩三人，心中都是这般认为。
他们都从未听说过什么纳灵入体，也从未听说过什么修仙。
倒是有曾听闻，在一些较为古老的武修门派之中，对境界有过一些別称。
如此想来，倒是有这种可能。
楚风並未回应。
他只是静静的看著几人。
他了解这个徒弟的性子。
有这等机会在，簫火火是不会放过装一波的机会的。
果不其然，看四人的注意力都放在了自己身上。
簫火火立即哼著鼻子，掷地有声的傲然道：
“大长老。”
“这当然不是什么武者境界的別称！”
在四人的目光中，他有些不屑，甚至是嗤之以鼻的道：
“武者？”
“武者是什么玩意，这等小道，也敢碰瓷修仙？”
“修仙可是师尊传我的长生之道，那可是能修炼成仙的大道！”
整个萧家大堂，似乎都因簫火火这话，被屏静了声息。
萧斩四人呆愣了片刻，个个脸上都是惊疑不定。
良久，萧斩仿佛被定在原地，有些恍惚的失声道：
“长生之道，这怎么可能？”
content_en:
Xiao family lobby.
Xiao Zhan and the other four surrounded Xiao Huohuo in the center and stared at him closely.
Normally, the four of them would just think it was nonsense that Xiao Huohuo learned from that storybook and wouldn't take it to heart.
But now, Xiao Huohuo has brought back a master who cannot be ignored by the entire Lihuo Kingdom and has surpassed the level of a grand master.
What Xiao Huohuo said was difficult for them to ignore.
Those words just now echoed in the hearts of the four of them, as if they had tickled an itch.
The great elder also looked at Xiao Huohuo.
He was leaning on a cane with one hand, his brows were knitted into the Chinese character "Chuan", and he said in confusion:
"That's what the patriarch asked."
"Huo Huo, what are your nine auras and cultivating immortals?"
"I have lived for decades and traveled all over Jiangnan Road. Why have I never heard of it?"
The great elder raised his head and looked at Chu Feng:
[Remember the fastest novel site on the Internet 1?1???.???]
"Is it possible that it is some special skill of the senior, a title for the realm of warriors?"
Not only the Great Elder, but also the remaining Xiao Zhan and the other three people thought so in their hearts.
They have never heard of absorbing spirits into the body, nor have they heard of cultivating immortals.
However, I have heard that among some of the older martial arts sects, there are some other names for the realm.
Thinking about it this way, it is possible.
Chu Feng did not respond.
He just looked at a few people quietly.
He knew this apprentice's temperament.
With such an opportunity, Xiao Huohuo will not let go of the chance to show off.
As expected, the four people's attention was focused on him.
Xiao Huohuo immediately snorted and said proudly:
"Great Elder."
"Of course this is not another name for the warrior realm!"
In the eyes of the four people, he looked a little disdainful and even sneered:
"Warrior?"
"What the hell is a warrior? How dare someone of this lowly level dare to touch porcelain cultivators?"
"Cultivation as an immortal is the way to immortality taught to me by my master. It is the way to become an immortal through cultivation!"
The entire Xiao family lobby seemed to be silenced by Xiao Huohuo's words.
Xiao Zhan and the four others were stunned for a moment, with surprise and uncertainty on their faces.
For a long time, Xiao Zhan seemed to be frozen in place, and said in a daze:
"The way to immortality, how is this possible?"
title_en: Chapter 19 Martial arts dare to challenge me. I cultivate the path of immortality and immortality. Chapter 20 Xiao Huohuo, Third Elder, don’t worry, I won’t hurt you.
